title: Exchange Place and Regas on the Original Dixieland Jazz Band record
summary: Allen plays a record of Regas with the Original Dixieland Jazz Band; they end the discussion because Allen has a lunch.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And it's printed by Revers and Broome, Exchange Place, New Orleans. Yeah. So he switched to New Orleans Printer. You never did hang around Exchange Place, huh? No. That's where a lot of musicians used to hang around. I know Nick LaRocca. Oh, okay. Did you ever hear Blue and the Blues by Regas? I'll play it for you. Maybe we can stop the machine if we have time. Yeah. Let me stop.
Which one is that? This is Blue and the Blues coming up. Is that it?
This is the original Dixieland Jazz Band. Yeah. They let the Regas play with them for a while.
I don't want to take too much of your time. What about you? You've got to go somewhere for one o'clock. It's only 12 and 20 after 12.
I just have to meet a blonde for lunch.
Yeah, that's Regas. Well, you can let me know later when you find out whether you want me to play or not, you know.
